name: PETGAS
recent: PETRONAS Gas Berhad 于2026年11月19日公布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩，并宣布第三次中期股息每股18仙。同期，雇员公积金局（EPF）和退休基金局（KWAP）多次申报大股东权益变动。
notable: 宣布第三次中期单层股息每股18仙。
公布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩。
EPF与KWAP在11月多次申报大股东权益变动。
earnings: 2026年第三季度营收为16.07亿令吉，环比增长7.1%，同比微降0.7%；净利为6.31亿令吉，环比增长39.1%，同比增长41.9%；净利率为39.2%，高于上一季度的30.2%。

recent_en: PETRONAS Gas Berhad announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 19 November 2026 and declared a third interim dividend of 18 sen per share. During the same period, the Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) and Kumpulan Wang Persaraan (Diperbadankan) (KWAP) filed multiple substantial shareholder changes.
notable_en: Declared a third interim single-tier dividend of 18 sen per share.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
EPF and KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder changes in November.
earnings_en: Q3 2026 revenue was MYR 1,607.2 million, up 7.1% QoQ and down 0.7% YoY; net income was MYR 630.5 million, up 39.1% QoQ and up 41.9% YoY; net margin was 39.2%, higher than 30.2% in the previous quarter.
